name: Padam Cotton Yarns Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Padam Cotton Yarns Ltd deals in textile, garments, and other allied products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview and strategic shift:[1]
a) PCYL was previously engaged in manufacturing cotton yarns at its Karnal plant.
b) After a fire incident in FY23, it ceased all cotton yarn operations.
c) Interim trading in agricultural implements, motors, and pumps was also discontinued.
d) The company shifted its focus to investments and lending for long-term sustainability.
e) In FY24, it actively pursued lending operations and invested in shares, securities, and cotton futures on MCX.

pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 4.39%.
Company has delivered good profit growth of 111% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 2.80% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.11.7 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 341 days.
